title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: per-cycle late fee with membership add-on charge
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, the fee assessed per currently unpaid billing cycle equals the tier's flat late-payment fee amount, plus a 10 percent pass-through add-on charge of the enrolled employee's own club membership late fee — obtained by reading that membership's own most recent late-payment fee charge on file, which reflects its tier's current rate — rounded to 2 decimal places, reflecting shared collections overhead across the household's accounts.

Worked example (hypothetical): if a tier's flat late-payment fee amount were $60.00 and the employee's own club membership late fee were $30.00, the add-on charge would be 10 percent of $30.00, which is $3.00, and the fee per currently unpaid billing cycle would be $60.00 plus that $3.00 add-on charge, $63.00.
